title: Why inflation is heating up again across almost every category.mp4
summary: Bloomberg desk reaction to the September 2026 CPI: energy re-accelerated with the Middle East and Ukraine, core came in slightly hot, memory chips lift electronics, and almost every category sped up.

assertions.quote: we have continued to have energy prices that have been persistently high here.
almost every category saw re-acceleration. Energy's not alone.
the memory chip pricing has been feeding its way through into some of those consumer electronics products

verdicts.note: DRAM and NAND contract prices rose sharply from late 2025 on AI data-center demand, lifting PC and phone prices.

assertions.quote: That is pretty significantly spiking back up with everything we see going on in the Middle East and Ukraine.
